events.evidence: South Korea states that North Korea has expressed a desire to denuclearize the Korean Peninsula without attaching preconditions such as withdrawing US troops
Ukrainian ecology minister Ostap Semerak warns of a major nuclear disaster if pro-Russia separatists go forward with a plan to flood a mine where a small nuclear weapon was tested in the 1970s.
The United States National Transportation Safety Board declares metal fatigue caused a fan blade failure that killed a passenger on April 16

label.note: North Korea denuclearization signal supportive; Ukraine nuclear warning and aviation safety adverse.
